recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-8881; any future grammar cleanup in the Bundle narrative should be separate editorial work rather than required reconciliation for this tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-8881 asked whether request was compulsory in transaction Bundle entries after older Bundle prose referred to a non-existent transaction element while the HTTP page said each entry carried request details.
initial_application: Commit 22a3bff18945f8c59c8fd95f939ec87a590a6a1c directly applied #8881 by replacing the erroneous transaction-element wording with request-element wording; related cleanup commits #8874 and #8818 handled the same wording family.
additional_context: Later Published decisions FHIR-14550 and FHIR-14551 made transaction/batch Bundle.entry.request mandatory and updated HTTP prose to SHALL. FHIR-38942 then moved redundant SHALL prose into Bundle invariants, leaving bdl-3c as the authoritative conformance rule. Community searches found no conflicting rationale.
reconciliation: No source change was made because current source/bundle/bundle-notes.xml, source/http.html, source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml, and the transaction/batch profiles already state or enforce the mandatory request requirement in active build-scope source.
